request.identity: scope from immutable view; existing resource addressed by exact scoped ResourceRef; no name lookup

path_fields.project_id: ref.ID escaped once as one segment

request.optional_fields: nil omitted; explicit false/empty preserved; nullable project fields distinguish omitted/null/value

body.mapping: Create: name, description, skip_quotas_init. Update: name, description, custom_url, theme.brand_color/color/logo. Ref never serialized. Nullable fields use types.Null/Value.

request.validation: name length 1..64 Unicode codepoints; description 0..255 when present; valid UTF-8; documented nullable fields accept explicit null; no hidden defaults

response.field_mapping: All properties in the operation response schema; optional values preserve absence; arbitrary-precision Integer/Number; known RFC3339 timestamps normalized to UTC; provider ref field discarded
response.resource_ref: Create requires nonempty provider ID. Exact Get/Update use request ref when optional response ID is absent; a present response ID must match. List refs only for returned IDs. Scope, endpoint and generation from the call.

errors.404: not_found for safe reads; mutation rejection only when documented
errors.transport_loss: unknown_outcome after possible mutation transmission; exact request refs preserved
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error with accepted Receipt and trustworthy provider IDs already extracted
errors.message: fixed SDK message; raw provider messages discarded

retry: bounded safe reads; mutation single attempt, never replay

wait.availability: unavailable; provider CRUD binding does not imply a wait contract

recovery.availability: unavailable for root handle; exact Get is observational and does not prove authorship of unknown mutation

timeout: CallTimeout; CollectionTimeout shared across list pages
